title: Eradane Maduve
desc: Humiliated by his family and friends after a work suspension, a desperate Vishwanath seeks to save face through a reckless affair. His plan backfires when he discovers his wife has a similar idea.

title: Vikrant Rona
desc: When Vikrant Rona sets off to investigate a gruesome murder, a series of tragic deaths leads him to discover a supernatural connection. Subsequently, with varying clues, Vikrant must find the killer.

title: Hebbuli
desc: In order to uncover the truth behind his brother's death, Ram investigates the case but faces several obstacles as he attempts to fight against the corrupt system and protect his family.

title: Pailwaan
desc: A coach on the hunt for a new fighter finds Krishna, an orphan mentored by Sarkar. Krishna evolves into Kichcha, making a name for himself in the boxing ring.

title: Max
desc: Inspector Arjun arrests two men for crashing into the police station. Soon, he desperately rushes to clear his name as the two are found dead.

title: Putnanja
desc: Putnanja, a poor farmer, falls in love with Roja, a city-bred woman. They get married despite opposition from her mother, but differences soon crop up between them.
